title: Follow two circuits across one interface
kind: Original teaching schematic, not a specimen or a scale drawing

stages.title: Uterine spiral artery
stages.question: Whose vessel supplies this compartment?
stages.answer: A maternal vessel supplies maternal blood toward the intervillous space.

stages.title: Intervillous space
stages.question: Does this blood lie inside the fetal capillary?
stages.answer: No. It bathes the outside of villous trophoblast surfaces.

stages.title: Maternal venous return
stages.question: Where does the maternal blood return?
stages.answer: Toward maternal uterine veins, not through the umbilical vein.

stages.title: Umbilical arteries
stages.question: Which direction does fetal blood travel here?

stages.title: Villous capillaries
stages.question: What separates this blood from maternal blood?
stages.answer: The intervening villous interface, including trophoblast and fetal capillary wall, with local variations in intervening tissue.

stages.title: Umbilical vein
stages.question: Where does the fetal blood go after exchange?

centralNote: Solutes cross the intervening interface; the diagram does not join the two blood circuits.
